description: Use this when the user wants photography golden hour shoot windows for a city and a date range, with an ICS calendar file and CSV table. Choose morning, evening or both. Limits: 1–31 days, cities with population 50,000+ (plus Tromso), years 1900–2100, flat sea-level horizon; missing polar windows are reported and calendar events are only included for existing windows. Does not access or change a calendar.

city.description: City name, for example New York. Cities with population 50,000+ are supported; the largest same-name match is used.

country.description: Optional country name or two-letter code to narrow the match, for example US.

days.description: Number of consecutive days, 1 to 31, for example 7.

period.description: Light windows to include, for example evening. A continuous window includes both periods.

start_date.description: First local date in YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-10-12.

state.description: Optional US state name or abbreviation, for example NY or New York.

name: plan_golden_hour_shoot
title: Plan golden hour shoot
